overview: Ridgeline Freight Solutions is seeking to implement a modern customer portal to enhance customer experience and significantly reduce the manual operational workload on their internal teams. The proposed solution will provide self-service capabilities for shipment tracking, invoice management, and online payments, integrated with their existing TMS and Finance systems, and hosted on AWS.

customer_objectives.text: Establish a modern customer portal to improve customer experience and reduce manual operational overhead.
Minimize the time the operations team spends manually answering tracking and invoice queries.

solution_highlights.text: The core scope includes a customer portal for shipment tracking, invoice management, and online payment capabilities.

solution_highlights.validation_reason: The customer's preferred cloud platform requires confirmation.
solution_highlights.text: The solution will be hosted on AWS, leveraging serverless and containerized services.

solution_highlights.validation_reason: Specific system details and payment gateway choice require customer confirmation.
solution_highlights.text: Integration with the TMS and Finance systems is assumed to use modern REST APIs, and Stripe is assumed for online payments.

solution_highlights.validation_reason: This is a recommended feature beyond the explicitly stated customer requirements.
solution_highlights.text: An AI-powered assistant is recommended to handle online shipment queries, enhancing self-service capabilities.

key_risks.validation_reason: Customer confirmation is needed for assumed user and shipment volumes.
key_risks.text: The proposed solution relies on assumed mid-market user and shipment volumes, which require customer validation.

key_risks.validation_reason: Specific details of TMS and Finance systems, including API capabilities, are pending customer input.
key_risks.text: Integration approach assumes modern REST APIs for TMS and Finance systems, pending specific system identification and API documentation.

key_risks.validation_reason: The choice of payment gateway requires customer confirmation.
key_risks.text: Stripe is assumed as the payment gateway, which needs customer confirmation.

key_risks.validation_reason: Specific security and authentication requirements need customer confirmation.
key_risks.text: Standard web security and username/password authentication with MFA are assumed, pending customer-specific security requirements.

key_risks.validation_reason: The project timeline and budget are based on assumptions and require customer validation.
key_risks.text: A standard 4-month implementation timeline is assumed for the initial MVP release, pending customer confirmation of timeline and budget.

next_steps.text: Engage with Ridgeline Freight Solutions to confirm all pending assumptions regarding user volumes, system integrations, payment gateway, security standards, timeline, and budget.
Gather specific details on the TMS and Finance systems, including product names, versions, and API documentation.
Confirm the preferred cloud platform and hosting environment with the customer.
